Name: Dapper Krobus
Author: ProbablyAnonymous
Description: It is a simple XNB file edit that affects only the portrait of Krobus when you talk to him (did you know krobus only has one portrait model?).  I wanted my first mod to be simple, but sweet. After a quick unpack of the XNB file, i drew the hat in paint.net and then repacked the file.  Worked for me with no trouble.

Downloads.Description: This is the xnb file.  To install, drag this file to the previous krobus.xnb file and replace it.
